items.example: Infect enters English in the fourteenth century.
items.exampleCN: infect 于十四世纪进入英语。

items.meaning: having the nature of, able to
items.example: The suffix -ive forms infective.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ive 构成 infective。

items.example: Infective describes a particle that can cause infection.
items.exampleCN: infective 形容能够引起感染的颗粒。

items.example: The suffix -ity turns infective into infective plus -ity.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ity 把 infective 变成再加 -ity 的形式。

items.example: The suffix -ion gives infection alongside infectivity.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ion 与 -ity 并行走出了 infection。

definition_zh: 推论的；推断的；基于推测的
definition_en: based on reasoning from evidence rather than on direct observation or statement
core_image: 从两行脚印一路追踪，猜出那只动物刚刚走过
scene: 侦探没有亲眼看见窃贼，只能靠脚印做推论式判断。Having seen no burglar, the detective could only make an inferential judgement from footprints.
sceneCN: 这里 inferential 是「推论的」（第 1 个义项：靠推理从证据得出，而非直接观察所得）；句意：侦探没看见窃贼，只能根据脚印作出推论式判断。

pos.zh: 推论的；推断的
逻辑推理的（与直接感知相对）

derivatives.zh: 推断；推论，是整组词的核心动词
由 -ence 构成的名词，义为「推论；推断」
由 -ly 构成的副词，义为「以推论的方式；间接地」
由 -able 构成的形容词，义为「可推断的」

senses.title: Reached by reasoning, not seen directly
senses.definition: arrived at through reasoning from clues rather than through direct observation
senses.definitionCN: 通过根据线索推理得出，而不是通过直接观察得到的
senses.example: The conclusion was inferential, built from broken glass and wet mud.
senses.exampleCN: 这个结论是推论性的，由碎玻璃和湿泥推断而来。
senses.why: Infer means to carry a conclusion across from evidence, and -ial simply marks anything of that kind.
senses.whyCN: infer 意为把结论从证据（线索）里搬运出来，后缀 -ial 只是标明「属于这种性质」，所以推出来的东西就是 inferential。

senses.title: Pertaining to logic and reasoning
senses.definition: relating to the process of inference as studied in logic or psychology
senses.definitionCN: 与逻辑学或心理学所研究的推理过程相关的
senses.example: Her work compares inferential and memorial processes in children.
senses.exampleCN: 她的研究比较儿童的推理过程与记忆过程。
senses.why: The adjective can name not only the product of inference but the mental machinery that produces it.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词不只指推理的产物，也可以指产生产物的心理机制，于是成了「推理（过程）的」。

senses.title: Indirect, implied rather than stated
senses.definition: suggested or implied by context instead of being stated openly in words
senses.definitionCN: 由上下文暗示或隐含，而没有在字面上明说
senses.example: His silence was inferential: everyone understood the refusal.
senses.exampleCN: 他的沉默是隐含的：所有人都明白那是拒绝。
senses.why: If a meaning is carried across from what is said, it is there by inference and therefore only inferential.
senses.whyCN: 如果一个意思是从说过的话里「搬」过来的，那就是靠推断得出的，所以只是间接的、隐含的。

senses.title: Statistical inference in data work
senses.definition: describing methods that use sample data to draw conclusions about a whole population
senses.definitionCN: 描述用样本数据对总体下结论的那些方法
senses.example: Inferential statistics tests whether the groups really differ.
senses.exampleCN: 推断统计用来检验各组之间是否真的存在差异。
senses.why: The data version extends reasoning from clues to reasoning from a sample to an unknown whole.
senses.whyCN: 数据领域的用法把「从线索推理」扩展到「从样本推测未知总体」，只是把线索换成了数据。

senses.title: Formal term in linguistics and philosophy
senses.titleCN: 形式语用学中的推断用法
senses.definition: in specialized theory, describing meanings that listeners work out from context by reasoning
senses.definitionCN: 在专门理论中，描述听者通过推理从语境中求出的那些含义
senses.example: Pragmatics studies inferential meaning in everyday talk.
senses.exampleCN: 语用学研究的正是日常对话中的推断性含义。
senses.why: A technical label keeps the core image: the listener carries a meaning across from what the speaker left unsaid.
senses.whyCN: 专门术语保留了核心意象：听者把含义从说话者没有明说的部分里「搬运」出来。

intro.en: Inferential is built on Latin inferre, to carry in, plus the adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: inferential 建立在拉丁语 inferre（搬进来、带入）之上，再加形容词词尾 -al。

items.en: Ferire or ferre means to carry, and the prefix in- adds the direction into.
items.cn: 拉丁语 ferre 意为搬运，前缀 in- 加上「往里面」的方向。

items.en: Inferre means to bring in or, in logic, to bring a conclusion in from premises.
items.cn: inferre 意为带来；在逻辑中则指从前提中推出结论。

items.en: Inferentialis appears in medieval philosophical Latin for matters of logical inference.
items.cn: 中古哲学拉丁语中出现 inferentialis，指与逻辑推理有关的事项。

items.en: Inferential enters English in the sense of relating to inference.
items.cn: inferential 于十七世纪进入英语，意为与推理有关的。

items.en: Logic and early statistics widen the word to measured conclusions drawn from data.
items.cn: 逻辑学与早期统计学把该词扩展到从数据得出的可测结论。

items.en: Cognition research and statistical testing make inferential an everyday technical adjective.
items.cn: 认知研究与统计检验使 inferential 成为常用的技术形容词。

note.en: Inferential belongs with infer and inference, and sits near words that contrast guesses and direct observation.
note.cn: inferential 与 infer、inference 同属一族，并按「猜测」与「直接观察」的对照而与若干词相邻。

entries.definitionCN: 推理得出的结论；推论

entries.definition: to work out a conclusion from evidence
entries.definitionCN: 推断；推理

entries.definition: relating to what something refers to
entries.definitionCN: 指涉的；参照的（与 inferential 只是拼写相近，词源不同）

entries.definition: below the level of conscious awareness
entries.definitionCN: 阈下的；潜意识层面的（与直接感知相对）

entries.definition: based on guesswork rather than firm evidence
entries.definitionCN: 推测的；凭猜测的

entries.definition: arriving at a conclusion by strict logical steps
entries.definitionCN: 演绎的；由严格逻辑步骤得出结论的

normalIntro.en: Inferential is the adjective of the infer group: every -ial word points back to the -ence noun and the -er verb.
normalIntro.cn: inferential 是 infer 词族的形容词：-ial 形容词总能回到 -ence 名词和 -fer 动词。

normal.en: Infer plus -ence gives inference, the noun of deduction.
normal.cn: infer 加 -ence 得 inference，即推论的产物。

normal.en: Inference plus -ial gives inferential, relating to inference.
normal.cn: inference 加 -ial 得 inferential，意为与推论有关的。

normal.en: Compare preferential and referential: -ential is a frequent ending for relational adjectives.
normal.cn: 对比 preferential 与 referential：-ential 是常见的表关系形容词词尾。

normal.en: Keep inferential and referential apart: one is about reasoning, the other about what a word points to.
normal.cn: 分清 inferential 与 referential：前者讲推理，后者讲词语所指。

normal.en: Pair it with reasoning, statistics, and evidence, as in inferential reasoning and inferential statistics.
normal.cn: 常见搭配有 reasoning、statistics、evidence，例如推论式推理、推断统计、间接证据。

abstract.en: Picture a hunter reading footprints that lead into the fog.
abstract.cn: 想象猎人辨认一串通向雾中的脚印。

abstract.en: Picture a courtroom where the case is built from small clues.
abstract.cn: 想象法庭上，案子靠一个个细小线索拼起来。

abstract.en: Picture a hidden note slipping under a door.
abstract.cn: 想象一张暗藏的纸条从门缝底下滑进来。

examples.en: Their reading of the letter was inferential, based on what was never said.
examples.cn: 他们对这封信的解读是推论性的，依据的是信里从未明说的部分。

examples.en: Inferential statistics lets researchers generalise from a sample.
examples.cn: 推断统计让研究人员能够从样本推广到总体。

examples.en: The link between the two events remains inferential rather than proven.
examples.cn: 这两件事之间的联系仍属推断，而非已被证实。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因佛来说」——「因」为看「到」了「佛」「来」过留下的脚印，才「说」出它来过，这就是推论；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（向内）+ ferre（搬运）→ inferre（带入；在逻辑中从前提推出结论）→ 英语 infer / inference → 加 -ial 构成形容词 inferential，核心义为「把结论从证据里搬出来」。

sensesIntro.en: Inferential moves from conclusions drawn from clues, to the reasoning process itself, to implied meanings, and finally to statistics and formal theory.
sensesIntro.cn: inferential 从「由线索得出的结论」出发，扩展到推理过程本身、隐含含义，最后进入统计与形式理论的专门用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: footprints in the mud, and a mind that carries a guess out of them.
core.cn: 核心意象：泥地上的脚印，以及一颗从中搬出猜测的头脑。

branches.en: The everyday sense is a conclusion from direct clues.
branches.cn: 日常义项指从直接线索得出的结论。

branches.en: The psychological sense names the reasoning process itself.
branches.cn: 心理学义项指推理过程本身。

branches.en: The implied sense lives in things that are not said.
branches.cn: 隐含义项藏在没有说出口的话里。

branches.en: Statistics generalises from a sample to an unknown whole.
branches.cn: 统计义项从样本推广到未知的总体。

branches.en: Pragmatics studies meanings listeners infer from context.
branches.cn: 语用学研究听者从语境中推断出的含义。

intro.en: Inferential is the -ial adjective of a Latin verb-and-noun family: infer, inference, inferential, and the adverb in -ly.
intro.cn: inferential 是拉丁动词、名词同族词的 -ial 形容词：infer、inference、inferential，以及加 -ly 的副词。

latinIntro.en: Latin in- plus ferre, to carry, gives inferre; -entia and -alis are the Latin noun and adjective endings behind inference and inferential.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in- 加 ferre（搬运）构成 inferre；拉丁名词词尾 -entia 与形容词词尾 -alis 分别形成 inference 与 inferential。

items.example: The prefix in- points the carrying inward.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 in- 把「搬运」的方向指向内部。

items.example: Ferre is the carry stem behind infer, transfer, and refer.
items.exampleCN: ferre 是 infer、transfer、refer 共用的一条「搬运」词干。

items.example: Inferre adds the logical sense of concluding.
items.exampleCN: inferre 增加了「推出结论」的逻辑含义。

items.example: The suffix -ence forms inference from infer.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ence 由 infer 构成 inference。

items.example: The suffix -ial forms inferential.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ial 构成 inferential。

items.example: The suffix -able forms inferable, meaning able to be inferred.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -able 构成 inferable，意为可推断的。

items.example: The suffix -ly forms inferentially.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ly 构成 inferentially。

items.example: Transfer shares the ferre stem with infer.
items.exampleCN: transfer 与 infer 共享 ferre 词干。

items.meaning: to carry back, to point to
items.example: Refer shares the ferre stem with infer.
items.exampleCN: refer 与 infer 共享 ferre 词干。

definition_zh: 渗透；潜入；使渗入；渗透者
definition_en: to move secretly into an organization, place, or tissue, passing through layers without being noticed
core_image: 水珠顺着砖缝一点点渗进墙里，外面看不出痕迹
scene: 雨水沿石缝慢慢渗进墙体，造成墙皮剥落。Rainwater infiltrates the wall through the cracks and slowly peels off the paint.
sceneCN: 这里 infiltrate 是「渗入」（第 1 个义项：液体经细小缝隙透过表层）；句意：雨水通过缝隙渗入墙体，慢慢使墙皮剥落。

pos.zh: 渗透；使渗入
潜入；渗透进入（组织、地区）
渗透物；潜入者（医学与军事用语）

derivatives.zh: 由 -tion 构成的名词，义为「渗透；潜入」
由 -or 构成的施事名词，义为「渗透者；潜入者」
由 -ive 构成的形容词，义为「浸润性的；渗透的」
过去分词作形容词，义为「已被渗透的」

senses.title: Seep into a material through small gaps
senses.definition: of a liquid or gas, to pass slowly through tiny openings in soil, rock, or a surface
senses.definitionCN: 指液体或气体慢慢透过土壤、岩石或表层中的细小孔隙
senses.example: Storm water infiltrates the sandy soil within minutes.
senses.exampleCN: 雨水几分钟内就渗入沙质土壤。
senses.why: In- means into and filtrum means a filter, so the verb pictures liquid threading through a filter into the inside.
senses.whyCN: in- 表示「进入」，filtrum 是「滤器」，所以这个词本身就是「把液体过滤进内部」的画面，自然长出水渗入固体这一义项。

senses.title: Enter a place or group in secret
senses.definition: to get into a hostile place, organization, or country secretly and gradually
senses.definitionCN: 秘密而逐步地进入敌方地区、组织或国家
senses.example: One agent infiltrated the smuggling ring within a year.
senses.exampleCN: 一名特工在一年内潜入走私集团。
senses.why: A drop passing through a filter one gap at a time becomes a spy passing through a security system one person at a time.
senses.whyCN: 一滴水逐个孔隙穿过滤器，变成间谍逐个人地穿过安保体系，于是「渗入」被借为「潜入」。

senses.title: Bring people in one by one, unnoticed
senses.definition: to place people or things inside something slowly until they are part of it
senses.definitionCN: 把人或物慢慢地安插进去，直到成为其中的一部分
senses.example: The party infiltrated its members into local councils.
senses.exampleCN: 该政党把自己的成员渗透进了地方议会。
senses.why: The transitive use reverses the picture: instead of going through the filter, the agent pushes others through it.
senses.whyCN: 及物用法把画面倒过来：不是自己穿过滤器，而是把别人一个个推过去，于是有了「使渗透进入」。

senses.title: Movement of fluid in medicine and geology
senses.definition: in medical and earth-science writing, the movement of cells or water into a surrounding tissue or rock layer
senses.definitionCN: 在医学与地学写作中，指细胞或水进入周围组织或岩层
senses.example: Cancer cells infiltrate the surrounding tissue in thin sheets.
senses.exampleCN: 癌细胞以薄片状浸润周围组织。
senses.why: Technical fields keep the literal filter image, so the word becomes the neutral term for fluids or cells entering a medium.
senses.whyCN: 技术领域保留「滤过」的字面画面，于是这个词成了描述液体或细胞进入介质的中性术语。

senses.title: The noun for the thing that has got in
senses.definition: in specialized use, a substance that has seeped in, or a person who has entered secretly
senses.definitionCN: 专门用法中指已渗入的物质，或秘密进入的人
senses.example: The pathologist described the infiltrate as dense and even.
senses.exampleCN: 病理学家把这种浸润物描述为致密而均匀。
senses.why: A verb of entering can also name what has done the entering, which is a normal conversion in technical English.
senses.whyCN: 表示「进入」的动词也可以拿来指「已经进来的东西」，这是技术英语里常见的词性转换。

senses.title: An idea slipping quietly into the mind
senses.definition: to spread into a person s thinking or into a community so gradually that nobody notices it arriving
senses.definitionCN: 逐渐进入某个人的思想或某个群体，以至于没人注意到它何时到来
senses.example: Doubt had infiltrated every department long before the audit.
senses.exampleCN: 早在审计之前，怀疑就已经渗进了每个部门。
senses.why: The invisible seepage is the perfect image for ideas that arrive without a knock, so the metaphor runs without a seam.
senses.whyCN: 看不见的渗流最适合形容不敲门就进来的想法，所以这个比喻几乎不留缝合痕迹。

intro.en: Infiltrate joins Latin in- (into) to filtrum, a filter, so it first described liquid passing through a filter.
intro.cn: infiltrate 把拉丁语前缀 in-（进入）与 filtrum（滤器）拼在一起，最初形容液体透过滤器。

items.en: Filtrum, probably borrowed from a Germanic word for felt, names the felt used as a filter.
items.cn: filtrum 很可能借自日耳曼语中表示「毛毡」的词，指用作滤器的毡。

items.en: Medieval authors use infiltratio for fluid soaking into a porous body.
items.cn: 中古拉丁语作者用 infiltratio 指液体浸入多孔物体。

items.en: The verb appears in early modern scientific English for liquids seeping through a medium.
items.cn: 该动词以「液体透过介质」之义出现在早期近代科学英语中。

items.en: Military and political writing borrows the word for spies and troops entering secretly.
items.cn: 军事与政治写作借用该词，指间谍与部队秘密进入。

items.en: Hydrology and pathology adopt it as a neutral technical term for water and cells entering a body.
items.cn: 水文学与病理学把它采用为描述水与细胞进入介质的中性术语。

items.en: Infiltrate now also names ideas that spread quietly into opinion.
items.cn: 如今的 infiltrate 也用来形容悄悄渗入舆论的观念。

note.en: Infiltrate is built from the filter root, so its look-alikes are other members of the same latin nest, while its near meanings are verbs of quietly getting in.
note.cn: infiltrate 由「滤器」词根构成，形近词是同属这一拉丁词巢的成员，近义词则是表示「悄悄进入」的一组动词。

entries.definition: to pass liquid through a material that holds back solids
entries.definitionCN: 过滤；使通过滤器
过滤；过滤过程

entries.definition: the act of seeping or slipping in
entries.definitionCN: 渗透；潜入

entries.definition: to get into or through something
entries.definitionCN: 穿透；刺入

entries.definition: to spread through every part of something
entries.definitionCN: 弥漫；渗透到……各处

entries.definition: to flow slowly through small openings
entries.definitionCN: 渗漏；慢慢透过

normalIntro.en: Infiltrate splits cleanly into in (into) plus filtrate (filter), so the word is a liquid going through a filter.
normalIntro.cn: infiltrate 可干净地拆成 in（进入）加 filtrate（过滤物），整词就是一滴液体穿过滤器。

normal.en: In plus filtrate gives infiltrate: filtering into the inside.
normal.cn: in 加 filtrate 得 infiltrate，即「过滤着进到里面」。

normal.en: The plain verb filter and the noun filtration share the same filter root.
normal.cn: 普通动词 filter 与名词 filtration 共享同一个「滤器」词根。

normal.en: Add -tion for the act, as in infiltration; add -or for the person, as in infiltrator.
normal.cn: 加 -tion 表示行为，如 infiltration；加 -or 表示人，如 infiltrator。

normal.en: Compare infiltrate with penetrate: infiltrate is slow and quiet, penetrate is direct and forceful.
normal.cn: 对比 infiltrate 与 penetrate：前者缓慢而隐蔽，后者直接而有力。

normal.en: Its collocations usually name the target: infiltrate an organisation, infiltrate the ranks, infiltrate into the soil.
normal.cn: 它的搭配通常点明目标：渗透进组织、潜入内部、渗入土壤。

abstract.en: Picture coffee slowly soaking up through a paper filter.
abstract.cn: 想象咖啡慢慢透过一张滤纸往上走。

abstract.en: Picture a stranger in uniform blending into a holiday crowd.
abstract.cn: 想象一个穿制服的陌生人混进节日人群里。

abstract.en: Picture a rumour that everyone knows yet no one remembers hearing.
abstract.cn: 想象一个无人记得从何听来的传言，却人人都知道。

examples.en: Heavy rain can infiltrate the soil in a few hours.
examples.cn: 大雨能在几小时内渗入土壤。

examples.en: Two journalists infiltrated the closed meeting and recorded everything.
examples.cn: 两名记者潜入闭门会议并录下了一切。

examples.en: Tumours that infiltrate nearby tissue are harder to remove.
examples.cn: 浸润周围组织的肿瘤更难切除。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因非偷累他」——水「因」为「非」得「偷」偷摸摸、一点一点「累」积地「他」处渗透，才叫渗入；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 in-（进入）+ filtrum（毛毡滤器，一般认为借自日耳曼语「毛毡」）→ 中古拉丁语 infiltratio（浸入）→ 英语 infiltrate，核心义为「像液体穿过毡滤一样，不易察觉地进到内部」。

sensesIntro.en: Infiltrate begins with liquid seeping through pores, widens to spies and troops slipping in, and ends with technical and figurative uses in medicine, hydrology, and opinion.
sensesIntro.cn: infiltrate 从液体透过孔隙渗入开始，扩展到间谍与部队潜入，最后进入医学、水文与舆论领域的技术与比喻用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: droplets threading through the fibres of a felt filter.
core.cn: 核心意象：水滴一根根纤维地穿过毛毡滤器。

branches.en: The literal sense is liquid seeping through small openings.
branches.cn: 字面义是液体透过细小孔隙。

branches.en: The security sense is a person passing through a system unnoticed.
branches.cn: 安全义项是人穿过安保体系而不被发现。

branches.en: The transitive sense pushes other people through the same gap.
branches.cn: 及物义项是把别人推过同一道缝隙。

branches.en: Earth science and medicine keep the literal image with technical labels.
branches.cn: 地学与医学用技术术语保留了字面画面。

branches.en: What entered can be named, and so can the idea that entered unnoticed.
branches.cn: 进来的东西可以被命名，悄悄进入的观念同样如此。

intro.en: Infiltrate is formed from the prefix in-, the filter stem, and the verb ending -ate, with infiltration and infiltrator built on the same base.
intro.cn: infiltrate 由前缀 in-、滤器词干与动词词尾 -ate 构成，infiltration 与 infiltrator 建立在同一词基上。

latinIntro.en: Latin filtrum is the filter; -are, -atio, and -or are the Latin endings that make the verb, the action noun, and the person noun.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 filtrum 意为滤器；拉丁词尾 -are、-atio、-or 分别构成动词、行为名词与人称名词。

items.example: The prefix in- marks movement to the inside.
items.exampleCN: 前缀 in- 标记向内部移动。

items.example: Filtrum is the felt used to strain liquids.
items.exampleCN: filtrum 是用来滤液体的毡。

items.example: The suffix -ate forms infiltrate as a verb.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ate 把 infiltrate 构成动词。

items.example: The suffix -ation forms infiltration.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ation 构成 infiltration。

items.example: The suffix -or forms infiltrator.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -or 构成 infiltrator。

items.example: The suffix -ive forms infiltrative.
items.exampleCN: 后缀 -ive 构成 infiltrative。

items.example: Filter is the everyday member of the same family.
items.exampleCN: filter 是同族的日常用词。

items.example: Filtration shares the root with infiltrate.
items.exampleCN: filtration 与 infiltrate 共享词根。
